source: Verified research, Kiro CLI V3 / IDE 1.x entry: https://kiro.dev/docs/hooks/types/ (code blocks recovered from the rendered HTML) and https://kiro.dev/docs/cli/v3/hooks-migration.md; the skeptic re-fetched every page on 2026-11-21 (hook_pre_tool, hook_session_start, hook_stop corrected).

selection.sniffNote: The verified research names no Kiro hook env var (the IDE sets USER_PROMPT only on prompt hooks), so Kiro is picked by --agent kiro or CI_AGENT.
selection.bareNote: Kiro's PreToolUse payload is Claude-shaped. Kiro CLI 3.4.0+ honours the Claude hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision deny at exit 0 (hooks/types.md); older CLIs and the IDE need --agent kiro for the exit 2 deny.

deny.source: Kiro hook_pre_tool (skeptic): exit exactly 2 to deny on every surface; the CLI sends STDERR to the LLM.

context.source: Kiro hook_session_start: exit 0 and plain STDOUT is added to the agent's context.

PreToolUse.source: Kiro hook_payload_example, verbatim from hooks/types.md, with the shell tool execute_bash; the doc example is read_file, so execute_bash's command key is not documented

PostToolUse.source: Kiro hook_post_tool: PostToolUse adds tool_response, e.g. {success, result}

UserPromptSubmit.source: Kiro hook_user_prompt: verbatim code block from hooks/types.md

SessionStart.source: Kiro hook_session_start: verbatim code block {hook_event_name: agentSpawn, cwd, session_id}; V3 accepts AgentSpawn and agentSpawn

SessionEnd.source: Kiro hook_session_start: SessionEnd exists on CLI V3 only; its input keys are not documented

Stop.source: Kiro hook_stop: verbatim code block {hook_event_name: Stop, cwd, session_id}

evidence.source: Kiro hook_payload_example (hooks/types.md: read_file with tool_input.path) and hook_post_tool (tool_response {success, result}); fs_write takes path (research tool_names)
